do-deep-work-without-fighting: Do deep work without fighting your browser.
focus-sessions-a-gentle-pause: Focus sessions, a gentle pause before distracting sites, honest statistics and care for your eyes. One free extension that keeps your data on your device.
start-a-session-and-distracting: Start a session and distracting sites pause until the timer ends, then open again by themselves. Add five minutes when you are in the flow. Take the break when you are done.
a-breath-instead-of-a: A breath instead of a wall.
when-habit-pulls-you-to: When habit pulls you to a distracting site, Elvani asks for one slow breath and shows the plan you wrote for this moment. Still need it? Continue. No guilt, no lockout.
do-you-really-need-youtube: Do you really need youtube.com right now?
if-i-want-to-open: If I want to open youtube.com, then I will stand up and drink water.
every-twenty-minutes-look-far: Every twenty minutes, look far away.
the-20-20-20-rule: The 20-20-20 rule, counted in real, active screen time and not by the clock. A calm twenty-second break page does the rest, and a quiet reminder tells you when it is time for bed.
find-something-about-six-metres: Find something about six metres away and rest your gaze on it. Let your shoulders drop.
time-per-site-and-per: Time per site and per hour, your best focus hours, how close your estimates were, and one small idea for next week. Honest numbers, counted on your device.
about-50-min-a-day: About 50 min a day went to reddit.com. A 30 min limit would give time back.
16-looks-any-accent-colour: 19 looks, any accent colour, your own fonts and 69 photo backgrounds, with a free-form editor for the new tab. Pick a look on the right: this page will follow.
69-backgrounds-for-your-new: 69 backgrounds for your new tab, each with type that stays readable. Or put your own photo there, and let the clock stand behind the mountain.
photographs-by-their-authors-under: Photographs by their authors, under the Unsplash licence or CC0. Every one is credited in the corner of the page and in the credits file.
looks-each-in-light-and: looks, each in light and dark
your-day-stays-on-your: Your day stays on your device.
no-account-no-ads-nothing: No account, no ads. Nothing leaves your device unless you switch it on; the one optional thing is anonymous usage numbers, which you can read before they are sent.
never-full-addresses-page-titles: Never full addresses, page titles or content.
every-line-is-on-github: Every line is on GitHub; each release is built twice and must match byte for byte.
not-used-for-ads-or: Not used for ads or money. Made by one person.
what-is-stored-on-this: what is stored, on this device only
full-addresses-page-titles-page: full addresses · page titles · page content
requests-to-the-network-unless: requests to the network, unless you say yes
yes-eyetime-is-made-by: Yes. Elvani is made by one person, has no paid tier and no ads. The code is public under the Functional Source License, which becomes Apache 2.0 after two years.
does-it-see-the-pages: Does it see the pages I visit?
no-it-keeps-the-domain: No. It keeps the domain name and the seconds spent there, on your device. Not the full address, not the title, nothing from the page.
what-are-the-optional-anonymous: What are the optional anonymous numbers?
if-you-say-yes-once: If you say yes, once a week Elvani sends a few counts: on how many days you used it, how often you used each feature, your look and language. Never sites, tasks, notes, goals or times. It is off until you agree, you can read the exact report first, and you can stop at any time.
which-browsers-does-it-work: Which browsers does it work in?
chrome-edge-brave-and-arc: Chrome, Edge, Brave and Arc install it from the Chrome Web Store. For Firefox, download it from the release page on GitHub.
will-it-lock-me-out: Will it lock me out of a site I need?
only-if-you-ask-it: Only if you ask it to. By default a distracting site gets a short pause and a “continue” button; strict sessions and hard blocks exist for the days you want them.
no-account-about-a-minute: No account. About a minute to set up. Edge, Brave and Arc install it from the same store.
meta-title: Elvani — focus, screen time and eye care for your browser
meta-desc: Free browser extension with readable source code: focus sessions, a gentle pause before distracting sites, honest screen-time statistics and eye-care reminders. 19 looks, 12 languages. Everything stays on your device.
eyes-thank-you: Your eyes thank you. Break logged.
